name: spindev-deploy

interface.longDescription: Deployment-target and on-prem infrastructure skills: fly.io provisioning and ops, sprites.dev guardrails, self-hosted Forgejo (LTS) for GitHub mirroring and on-prem-only repos, and a two-destination restic backup chain with append-only NAS rest-server and write-only Cloudflare R2.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this app for fly.io deployment.
Set up Forgejo to mirror my GitHub repos.
Wire up restic backups to NAS and Cloudflare R2.
Use sprites.dev correctly from Git Bash.
